sources.covers: Full list plus per-trophy unlock methods, roadmap and 100% checklist

sources.covers: Full guide with per-trophy methods, screenshots and roadmap

sources.covers: Full 55-trophy list (work in progress); platinum estimate up to 300+ hours

sources.name: KeenGamer

sources.covers: Platinum roadmap, full 55-trophy table and 100% completion tables

meta.verified: Names, descriptions, grades and hidden flags were cross-checked trophy by trophy between Insider Gaming and GTABase, both read in full on 20 Nov 2026: 55 of 55 agree. PowerPyx, Push Square and KeenGamer were read the same day and agree on the list except for one grade (see disagreements).
meta.platinumHoursNote: PowerPyx, GTABase and KeenGamer estimate about 200 hours to platinum; Push Square allows up to 300 hours or more. The per-trophy hours in this guide add up to about 200.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.

steps.text: Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation FIRST: the morning after Down to Earth, find Lucia in the kitchen at Jason's house, follow her to the balcony and accept. It is the only step that can vanish — after Chapter 1 it is gone.

Meditate at the 18 spots across Leonida's 10 meditation locations; a spot done with Jason and Lucia together counts twice. The last one needs both characters, unlocked after Coffee Break in Chapter 2.
Track the count under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. A spot only counts once the final 'zen' animation has played.
For the 100% checklist you only need 15 of 18 meditations — but this trophy wants all of them.

trophies.open: Does the Chapter 1 balcony meditation count toward the 18? GTABase and PowerPyx both say it is unclear — it raises the counter by 1 but is not marked as a Meditation Spot. Do it anyway: it costs nothing and may be required.

steps.text: Finish Gone Fishing, the opening mission of Chapter 1. It unlocks on its own — there is no extra step.
Story trophies cannot be missed: they pop as the missions end.
Finish Chapter 1. The trophy lands once you have played the first mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?
Keep a manual save at the end of each chapter — there is no mission replay, and a spare save is the only way back.
Finish Chapter 2. It is awarded as Chapter 3 begins, after Welcome to Vice City.
Story only — nothing to do beyond playing the missions through.
Complete Breakfast Run in Chapter 2. It pops during the mission itself.
No side requirement: just play the mission to its end.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.

steps.text: Meet Cal in Feng Shui (Chapter 1), then wait for his text: it marks a fishing spot west of Key Lento with a purple icon.
Work through Cal's fishing quests and beat him in his challenge. Bring a boat and a rod — plenty are moored near the spot.

versions.text: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge after his text marks the spot.
Catch a Parrotfish over 2kg at the marked spot.

disagree.ruling: Both describe the same Cal quest. This guide follows the majority (beat Cal) and treats the parrotfish as the likely catch inside that challenge.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.

steps.text: Kenton's line starts in Chapter 1 (green KR icon, Key Lento) after Island Dreams. He marks purple chest icons — dive, use the metal detector, and dig the treasure up from the ocean floor.
Clear all 7 shipwrecks and turn the treasures in. He goes quiet after Chapter 1 and texts Jason again later, so the line is not missable.
Track it under Progress > Collections > Kenton's Treasures (also Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees).
Finish any one arcade game: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III or Time Jackers Rewind on the TV at home, or Bang For Your Buck on cabinets around Leonida.
You only have to reach the end — beating every challenge inside the game is not required. It is open from Chapter 1.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.

steps.text: Moses' Chapter 2 mission installs the Scooter Bros app. Drive a stolen vehicle to his garage in Port Gellhorn, choose Respray, then Register.
At first he only takes cars without trackers; from Chapter 3 any Pay 'n' Spray registers tracked ones too. Each registration costs money, so use cheap cars and bikes.
You need free garage space first — see Little Boxes. Ten different vehicles unlock it.
After Daily Driver in Chapter 2, the Vice City Real Estate app appears on your phone. Buy all 8 garages through it — about $160,000 in total.
The 4 garages the story gives you do not count; only the 8 bought ones do. Push Square lists them by name and price, cheapest first (Mitchel Auto Center $4,000).
Robberies pay for this — buy the garages after a few bank jobs rather than saving up from scratch.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.

steps.text: Go to Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn — a gang operation, first marked by Hit Kingpin Bowling in Chapter 2. Bring sticky bombs for the safe.
Take all three valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the north-east table, and the safe in the north-east hallway.
The trophy pops once you lose the police. You do not need all three in one visit — the robbery respawns after a long while, so a missed item can be collected later.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.

steps.text: Billy's five jobs open at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. Do them in order; the fifth, Hometown Heroes, unlocks the trophy.
They stay available after the story, so there is no rush — but the club is also a good early source of cash.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.

steps.text: Bret's hunting line starts after Coffee Break in Chapter 2: he texts Jason, and Veteran Hunted in Lummox County kicks it off. It is Jason-only.
Hunt the animals on his Target Decks (purple icons) and bring them back as Jason. A clean one-shot kill pays more but is not required.
The 100% checklist needs all 15 Target Decks anyway, so finish the decks and this trophy should follow — but which animal triggers it is not confirmed yet by any source.

trophies.open: Which animal triggers the trophy is still unconfirmed — GTABase and PowerPyx agree on that. The decks are the safe path: complete all 15.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.

steps.text: Try all 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, a shooting range, pool, basketball (sink one basket), an arcade game, winning a race, and a stunt.
Check Progress > Activities first — most of these happen naturally, and you may only be one or two short.
Finish Chapter 3. It arrives after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life.
Story only.
Complete The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3.
Story only.
Complete Child's Play in Chapter 4.
Story only.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.

steps.text: Andy's line is Lucia-only and starts in Chapter 3, when he texts her an address in Belville. Do all five in order: Climbing the Cellerichain, Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, and Puff Puff Pass — the last one awards the trophy.
The quests stay available after the story.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.

steps.text: Randy's Wish List opens after the Chapter 3 mission that gets you the Key Cloner (Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS). Deliver the 16 sports cars on his list to his garage in west Vice City (RK icon).
Scan cars with the WAiNK app to see if they are on the list; hotel driveways around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach are the best places to look. Cars in better condition pay more.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.

steps.text: Jason-only. After Here, Kitty Kitty in Chapter 3, Tyrone has you destroy the synthetic labs marked in purple around Vice City.
Once enough labs are gone, his last job (Shut Down the Labs) awards the trophy. It stays available after the story.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.

steps.text: Finish Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 first — it gives you the Snap Gun and unlocks jewelry store robberies.

Break into a jewelry store through the locked back door with the Snap Gun (kicking it in sets off the alarm), find the note with the safe code in the back room, and empty the safe without being spotted.
Destroy the security footage and disable the alarm in the back room too. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City works well; the trophy pops shortly after you leave.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.

steps.text: With your partner beside you, rob 3 shops in a row while still wanted (flashing red and blue). Go in with body armor, sticky bombs and healing items.

The 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City (open after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3) sit close together. The trophy can take about 30 seconds to appear after the third shop — if it does not, rob a fourth.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.

steps.text: Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) in Chapter 3 gets you the Dye Pack Jammer. Rob banks and Payday Loans, then sell the marked bills to fences — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most.
It is a running total of $250,000, so the robberies for 100% get you there on their own. Bank vaults pay up to $205,000 in a single robbery.
Bank vaults open with the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is…. Follow a security van to its bank and get into the vault while it is open.
The haul is too heavy for one character, so hand a bag to your partner. Vaults always give 4 stars: escape on a fast bike, then switch vehicles.
5 of the 8 vaults are enough here, but the 100% checklist needs all 8 — and each pays up to $205,000. Yasmani sells van tips for $10,000.

disagree.ruling: Four of five sources list Silver. This guide lists Silver.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.

steps.text: Robbing a bank vault counts, as long as you then escape the red heat zone or reach a Pay 'n' Spray — so this usually pops during Maximum Withdrawal.
Earlier option: box in an armored truck, put a sticky bomb on its back doors, blow them open and get away.
Complete Headliners in Chapter 4.
Story only.
Complete VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4.
Story only.
Finish Chapter 4. It cannot be missed.
Story only.
Complete Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5.
Story only.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

steps.text: Finish the last mission of the story. Free roam carries on afterwards, so clean up everything else after the credits.
There is no mission replay, but no trophy depends on how you play a mission.

disagree.topic: Which mission is the final one?

versions.text: The final mission comes after Chapter 5 — Operation Savage Glory is a Chapter 5 mission.
Ties this trophy to Chapter 4's last mission, Starting From Zero — the same mission it names for the Chapter 4 trophy.

disagree.ruling: PowerPyx's entry looks like a copy slip (one mission cannot end two chapters). This guide follows GTABase and KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.area: Kelly County — train tunnel north of Ambrosia

steps.text: Possible once both characters are together (after Coffee Break in Chapter 2). Call your partner (hold Right on the D-pad, then Triangle / Y), get a 4-star Wanted Level and escape.

It only counts once you are out of the red heat zone. The train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County shakes off cops and helicopters well — and bank vault robberies always give 4 stars, so it often unlocks there.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.

steps.text: At VCIA, steal one of the big passenger jets docked at a departure gate's boarding bridge — planes parked out on the airfield do not count. Gates E3 and E4 are the easiest: drive through the airfield fence and use the door by the stairs next to the boarding bridge.
Back it out, take off and get about 1 km away from the airport. The trophy is a little delayed — keep flying until it pops.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.area: Mariana County — Mile Zero Air Station

steps.text: Steal a tank from Mile Zero Air Station on the south-west island of Mariana County — the tanks are at the south end of the base.
Take out enemies from inside it until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.area: Ocean Beach — Ocean View Rooftop Bar

steps.text: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach in Vice City and buy an Apple Martini.
Drink it while standing next to the bar, with the view in front of you.

versions.text: Concrete method with screenshots: Ocean View Rooftop Bar, Apple Martini, drink it by the bar.
The exact steps are not confirmed yet.

disagree.ruling: This guide follows PowerPyx (the only source with a tested method) and marks the trophy single-source.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.

steps.text: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City — only this car counts, not any other.

You can only steal it after obtaining the Key Cloner in Chapter 3 (Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS). Hack in, drive forward straight through the showroom window; the trophy pops a little delayed, once you are further down the street.

versions.text: Concrete method with screenshots: the blue Banshee, south Vice City showroom, Key Cloner required. A nod to the Banshee from GTA III.
The exact steps are not confirmed yet.

disagree.ruling: This guide follows PowerPyx (the only source with a tested method) and marks the trophy single-source.

steps.text: Max out Strength for both Jason and Lucia (Jason & Lucia > Strength in the pause menu). You can only start after Coffee Break in Chapter 2, when you can switch between both characters.
Work out at fitness clubs (Map > Activities) with your partner along: training one trains the other too. After the story you can also train at home.
Perform 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Most players get it without trying — turn on Criminal Profile notifications in Settings > UI to watch the count.
Do not push towards the Irredeemable profile: it is permanent, and cops get far more aggressive.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.area: Little Cuba — Payday Loans store (unverified lead)

steps.text: No source has confirmed the method yet. The description — 'Second time's the charm' — suggests succeeding at something on a second attempt.
PowerPyx offers one unverified guess: the Payday Loans store from the prologue, in Little Cuba, robbed again later in a specific manner. Treat that as a lead, not a method.

trophies.open: METHOD UNCONFIRMED. Every other trophy in this guide has a tested method; this one does not. Do not plan a run around the Payday Loans guess until a source confirms it.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.area: Kelly County — road NW of Starlet Motel

steps.text: Go solo to the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 2AM. The spawn is slightly random, not guaranteed.

If a blinking car is at the roadside, follow the path into the woods: a UFO (bright blue light in the sky) drops a woman it abducted. Talk to her, offer to help, and go back to her car at the roadside.
If the car is not there, drive away and come back until it spawns.

versions.text: Concrete method with screenshots: UFO easter egg NW of Starlet Motel, after 2AM, solo, blinking car.
The exact steps are not confirmed yet.

disagree.ruling: This guide follows PowerPyx (the only source with a tested method) and marks the trophy single-source.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl ’em over with a melee drive-by
trophies.area: Vice City / Ocean Beach — crowded streets

steps.text: Ride any bike and kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds.
Do it in a crowded area like Vice City or Ocean Beach.

versions.text: Bike, kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds, in a crowded area.
The exact steps are not confirmed yet.

disagree.ruling: This guide follows PowerPyx (the only source with a tested method) and marks the trophy single-source.

steps.text: Any 250 of the 397 stunts count, in any mix: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps.

Flying under bridges is the quickest way to rack them up, and the optional challenge on each stunt is not needed. Progress > Activities > Stunts shows your count, and the map can show every Stunt Spot.
Keep going past 250 — the 100% checklist wants 300.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.

steps.text: Get a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge: 42 golds across 12 ranges. Ranges also raise your Focus level, which helps with Gunslinger — do them first.
Track progress under Touch Pad > Activities > Shooting Ranges.

disagree.topic: How many shooting ranges are there?

versions.text: 2 shooting range locations: Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range (Port Gellhorn) and Griffin Shooting Range (Balsero).

disagree.ruling: Both can be true at once: 2 named locations holding 12 challenge ranges. This guide follows the 42-gold count.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.

steps.text: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. One win per location is enough here.
The 100% checklist wants all 42 drone races, so finish each location while you are there.
Win 20 different races; there are 40 to choose from. Winning the same race again does not count.
Race locations show on the map under Activities > Racing; most let you hire a car, so check its Rating first.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.

steps.text: Finish 8 qualifying stranger strands. Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete count; the quest lines of Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not.
The remaining qualifying strands are still being confirmed, so check the trophy's progress counter in your trophy list. None of them are needed for 100%, and all stay available after the story.
Complete 50 of the 80 Challenges; Progress > Challenges marks finished ones with a tick. Many complete themselves while you play.
The 100% checklist needs 70, so this one comes along the way — leave it for last and pick the easiest remaining challenges.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.

steps.text: Take down 5 enemies in a single Combat Focus (click both sticks while aiming). It only lasts a few seconds, so fill your Focus first — eat, drink or wash up at home; Adrenaline makes it last longer — and use an assault rifle.
Gang operation thugs work well; cops, soldiers and civilians do not seem to count. Level up Focus first (shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing, headshots) — it gets easier at Focus level 4.
Scan 100 different vehicles with the WAiNK app; you do not need to drive them. Stand next to a busy road and scan passing traffic.
The 100% checklist needs 200 base models, so you will get this anyway. There are 557 vehicles at launch.
Complete any 3 Collectible Card sets; you do not need all of them. The Collections section of the Progress menu shows how close each set is.
There are 18 sets in total; the 100% checklist needs 15, so this pops on the way.
Scan 100 WAiNK spots with the WAiNK phone app (hold Up on the D-pad, then R1 / RB). Any 100 count, from the 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures and the No Flusher tags.
Track them under Progress > Collections > WAiNK Locations.
Clear the fog from the whole map of Leonida. The quickest way is by plane, flying over every dark patch.
Use the in-game interactive map to spot the remaining dark areas.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.

steps.text: Rob one illegal gang operation (yellow map icons) from each of the 9 gangs; Progress > Gangs keeps count.
The 100% checklist needs all 39 operations, so this pops on the way.
A running total of $100,000 across every kind of shop. Guns, car mods and tattoos use it up fastest.
Shops show on the map under Touch Pad > Style.
The 100% checklist appears under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion once the story is finished — everything you did before already counts, and nothing on it is missable.

Demanded in full: all robberies (39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 Payday Loan jobs, 8 bank vaults), 33 underwater discoveries, every Shooting Range gold medal, all 42 drone races and all 15 of Bret's Target Decks.

The rest is a share, not the whole set: 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicle scans, 100 of 255 animal studies, 15 of 18 meditations, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts, 100 WAiNK scans, 15 of 18 card sets.
Work down the checklist itself rather than guessing — it is the only authoritative list of what is left.
This one pops on its own the moment the other 54 are done — there is nothing extra to do for it. Treat it as the finish line, not a task.
Budget around 200 hours in total, most of it on the 100% checklist behind A Long Road. Everything is single-player and offline, there is no difficulty trophy, and one playthrough is enough.

disagree.ruling: Three of five sources say about 200 hours. This guide budgets 200 and flags the spread — the per-trophy hours here add up to about 200.
